result.instructions: Tools for Klenty, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which prospect lists do we have, and how many prospects are in the Australia list?"; "Which prospects were created this month?"; "Start the 'Holiday campaign' cadence for jane@acme.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Klenty data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run klenty_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run klenty_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run klenty_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. klenty_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: klenty_list_lists
tools.title: List prospect lists
tools.description: List the prospect lists the team created in Klenty. Use a list name with klenty_list_prospects_by_list. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/lists.

tools.name: klenty_list_prospects_by_list
tools.title: List prospects in a list
tools.description: List the prospects in one prospect list, with paging. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects?listName=&start=&limit=.

tools.name: klenty_list_prospects_created
tools.title: List prospects created in a date range
tools.description: List the prospects created between two dates. With no end date, Klenty uses today. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects?startDate=&endDate=.

startDate.description: Date as yyyy/mm/dd (the form used in the Klenty docs).

endDate.description: Date as yyyy/mm/dd (the form used in the Klenty docs).

annotations.title: List prospects created in a date range

tools.name: klenty_list_prospects_updated
tools.title: List prospects updated in a date range
tools.description: List the prospects whose last update (last interaction) falls in a date range. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects?lastUpdatedDateStart=&lastUpdatedDateEnd=.

lastUpdatedDateStart.description: Date as yyyy/mm/dd (the form used in the Klenty docs).

lastUpdatedDateEnd.description: Date as yyyy/mm/dd (the form used in the Klenty docs).

annotations.title: List prospects updated in a date range

tools.name: klenty_get_prospect_status
tools.title: Get a prospect's status
tools.description: Get the cadence status and the prospect status of one prospect, by email. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects/{prospectEmail}/status.

tools.name: klenty_list_company_cadences
tools.title: List team cadences
tools.description: List all cadences (follow-up sequences of emails, tasks and calls) in the team. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/cadences.

tools.name: klenty_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions of the account, with their URLs and ids. Klenty API: GET /apis/v1/user/{email}/webhook/getall.

tools.name: klenty_create_prospect
tools.title: Create a prospect
tools.description: Create a prospect from the given fields. A list name that does not exist is created. Blank list = the default list. Klenty API: POST /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects.

List.description: List to add the prospect to (created if missing; default list if blank).

Owner.description: Email of the team member who owns the prospect.

CustomFields.description: Custom field values as a list of { key, value }.

tools.name: klenty_update_prospect
tools.title: Update a prospect
tools.description: Update the given fields of one prospect (found by its current email). Only the fields you pass change. Klenty API: POST /apis/v1/user/{email}/prospects/{prospectEmail}.

prospect_email.description: The prospect's current email address (the record to update).

Outcome.description: Prospect outcome. Must match the outcome name in Klenty exactly (case-sensitive).

List.description: Move the prospect to this list.

CustomFields.description: Custom field values as a list of { key, value }.

tools.name: klenty_start_cadence
tools.title: Start a cadence for a prospect
tools.description: Add a prospect to a cadence. The cadence then sends its emails and tasks to the prospect on schedule. Klenty API: POST /apis/v1/user/{email}/startcadence.

annotations.title: Start a cadence for a prospect

tools.name: klenty_stop_cadence
tools.title: Stop a cadence for a prospect
tools.description: Remove a prospect from one cadence, or from all cadences when no cadence name is given. Klenty API: POST /apis/v1/user/{email}/stopcadence.

cadenceName.description: The cadence to stop. Blank = remove the prospect from all cadences.

annotations.title: Stop a cadence for a prospect
